name: agent-tiers
description: The agent-tiers kit, plus two third-party companion plugins it is used alongside. The companions are listed for convenience: each is maintained upstream by its own author, and installing one is a separate choice.

plugins.name: agent-tiers
plugins.description: Lead/Worker/Advisor/Reviewer/Boss sub-agent tiers, workflow skills, and opt-in guard hooks grouped by level (Core by default).

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Third-party companion, maintained upstream at github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman: compressed, terse assistant output. Pinned to a known commit. Skip it if you already installed it from its own marketplace: a second copy runs its hooks twice.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Third-party companion, maintained upstream at github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail: pushes toward the simplest solution that works. Pinned to a known commit. Skip it if you already installed it from its own marketplace: a second copy runs its hooks twice.
